model_name.description: Name of the LLM model to use, such as gpt-4o, claude-3-opus, or a model hosted on a compatible endpoint.

api_key.description: API key for authenticating with the LLM provider.

account_id.description: Account ID for the LLM provider if required.

system_prompt.description: System prompt that instructs the LLM how to generate answers from the search results context. This prompt is prepended to every conversation.

max_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes of search context to send to the LLM.

history_collection.description: Name of the collection to store conversation history.

ttl.description: Time-to-live in seconds for conversation history entries.
